2PE.1.3-4.text: God has given believers everything needed for godly life

2PE.1.5-7.text: Peter urges believers to add good qualities to faith

2PE.1.8-9.text: Growing in these qualities keeps believers productive

2PE.1.10-11.text: Peter urges believers to be sure of God’s calling

2PE.1.12-15.text: Peter will keep reminding believers before he dies

2PE.1.16-18.text: Peter and others saw Jesus’ majesty and heard God’s voice

2PE.1.19-21.text: Prophecy in Scripture comes from God, not from men

2PE.2.1-3.text: False teachers will secretly bring in destructive ideas

2PE.2.4-6.text: God punished angels, the old world, and Sodom and Gomorrah

2PE.2.7-9.text: God rescued Lot and knows how to rescue the godly

2PE.2.10-11.text: False teachers who despise authority will be punished

2PE.2.12-14.text: False teachers are like animals, full of greed and sin

2PE.2.15-16.text: False teachers follow the way of Balaam

2PE.2.17-19.text: False teachers promise freedom but are slaves to sin

2PE.2.20-22.text: People who turn back from the truth end up worse off

2PE.3.1-2.text: Peter writes a second letter to remind believers

2PE.3.3-4.text: Scoffers will mock the promise that Jesus will come

2PE.3.5-7.text: God’s word judged the world by flood and will judge by fire

2PE.3.8-9.text: The Lord is patient because he wants all to repent

2PE.3.10-10.text: The Day of the Lord will come like a thief

2PE.3.11-13.text: Believers should live holy lives and wait for a new earth

2PE.3.14-16.text: Peter urges believers to be at peace and blameless

2PE.3.17-18.text: Peter warns believers to beware error and grow in grace
